list.title: Users
list.search: Search by email, name or id
list.noMatchHint: Try another email, name or id, or clear the filters.
list.emptyHint: People show up here once they sign up or accept an invitation.

blocked.mfaSelf: Turn yours off in the app
blocked.deleteSelf: Delete your own account in the app

signOutAll.title: Sign out everywhere?
signOutAll.text: Every session of {{email}} ends on every device, in the app and the panel. They can sign in again.

suspend.title: Suspend {{email}}?
suspend.description: Every session ends, in the app and the panel, and they can't sign in until restored. Their workspaces keep working for everyone else.

mfa.title: Turn off two-factor authentication?
mfa.description: The authenticator and recovery codes of {{email}} are removed (passkeys stay), every session ends, and they are emailed that an administrator did it. Do this only after confirming who is asking.

delete.title: Delete {{email}}?
delete.description: The account and its data are removed for good, the same as the user's own Delete account. This can't be undone.
delete.descriptionLeaves_one: The account and its data are removed for good, the same as the user's own Delete account. They leave {{n}} workspace. This can't be undone.
delete.descriptionLeaves_other: The account and its data are removed for good, the same as the user's own Delete account. They leave {{n}} workspaces. This can't be undone.
delete.soleOwner: They own a workspace that has other members. Transfer it or delete that workspace first.

detail.suspendedHint: They can't sign in; their workspaces keep working for everyone else.
detail.noWorkspacesHint: This person isn't a member of any workspace.
